aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.a825:
Easy to access switches to toggle side features on and off.
Most of them requires server restart or datapack reload. All of them, actually.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.826d:
For those who wants to remove Spirit Orbs generated in the world, more specifically...
  * Spirit Orbs generated in various chests
  * Spirit Orbs dropped by spawners and such
Note that bargain recipe for Heart Containers/Stamina Vessels will persist, even if this option is disabled.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.09e8:
For those who wants to remove entirety of Heart Containers from the game, more specifically...
  * Heart Containers obtained by "challenges" (i.e. Killing dragon, wither, raid)
  * Bargains using Heart Containers (custom recipes won't be affected)
Note that if this option is disabled while staminaVessels is enabled, "challenges" will drop Stamina Vessels instead.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.82b1:
For those who wants to remove entirety of Stamina Vessels from the game, more specifically...
  * Bargains using Stamina Vessels (custom recipes won't be affected)
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.5c09:
For those who wants to remove village structures added by this mod. Requires datapack reload.
Note that the structures generated in other places are NOT disabled by this option, and requires a datapack to remove.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.80d3:
Configuration file for player states.
You can adjust stamina delta (negative value means consumption / positive value means gain) and
recovery delay (in ticks) of all player states registered in the game.
To reload the config, use the following command: /paraglider reloadPlayerStates
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.2652:
If true, wind sources will generate updrafts that interact with Paraglider.
Wind sources and strength (i.e. height) of the updraft created can be adjusted with datapacks.
See online docs for more information: (work in progress)
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.2eee:
Multiplier to horizontal movement speed while paragliding.
Value of 0.5 means 50% of the speed, 2.0 means two times the speed and so forth.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.9e41: Durability of Paragliders. Set to zero to disable durability.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.a449:
If true, Ender Dragon will drop heart container(stamina vessel if heart container is disabled) upon death.
The vessel reward is per-player, meaning every player participated in the fight will get one vessel each.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.1d25:
If true, heart container/stamina vessel dropped by Ender Dragon will spawn on top of the end podium (the ending portal).
If false, it will be instead given directly to players.
This option does not change the amount of vessels given to each player. Intended as a compatibility feature for mods that change end podium location.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.10b7: If true, Wither will drop heart container(stamina vessel if heart container is disabled) upon death.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.a93e:
If true, Raids will give heart container(stamina vessel if heart container is disabled) upon victory.
The vessel reward is per-player, meaning every player participated in the Raid will get one vessel each.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.1daa: If true, Elder Guardian will drop a Spirit Orb upon death.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.550c: Amount of Spirit Orbs dropped from spawners. Fractional values are treated as a chanced drop, in addition to whole values which is guaranteed to drop.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.b1a1: Amount of Spirit Orbs dropped from completing trial. Fractional values are treated as a chanced drop, in addition to whole values which is guaranteed to drop.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.9630: Amount of Spirit Orbs dropped from completing ominous trial. Fractional values are treated as a chanced drop, in addition to whole values which is guaranteed to drop.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.8e77:
If true, various types of chest will have chances of having Spirit Orbs inside.
Does not change contents of already generated chests.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.c00c: Starting health points measured in number of hearts.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.4763:
Maximum amount of Heart Containers one player can consume.
Do note that the maximum health point is capped at value of 1024 (or 512 hearts) by Minecraft's default
attribute system; without modifying these limits, Heart Containers won't give you extra hearts beyond that.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.ae2b: Amount of stamina players start with. One full stamina wheel is equivalent to 1000 stamina.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.447d: Maximum amount of Stamina Vessels one player can consume. Higher value = higher maximum stamina.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.940f: Stamina increase per vessel. One full stamina wheel is equivalent to 1000 stamina.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.0f3c: Paragliding will consume stamina. Run /paraglider reloadPlayerStates after change.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.6ccc: Certain non-paragliding actions, such as running and swimming, will consume stamina. Run /paraglider reloadPlayerStates after change.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.3acd:
Configurable option for Towers of the Wild compat feature. Can be ignored if Towers of the Wild is not installed.
DEFAULT: Default option, spawn Deku Leaf in ocean tower chests and Paraglider in normal tower chests
DISABLE: Don't spawn anything
PARAGLIDER_ONLY: Spawn paraglider in both ocean and normal tower chests
DEKU_LEAF_ONLY: Spawn deku leaf in both ocean and normal tower chests, like a boss

aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.f422: Place dragon vessel on exit portal
